author: Jenna Lopez
body: Great call with Laura. They want Portland live before Q4 peak season and see us as the obvious choice. Expansion is all but done.

author: Mike Davis
body: Emily called: their scheduled export times out on the big workspace, which is why May's invoice is late. Told her engineering has the export timeout; she will pay once the export runs.

author: Mike Davis
body: Follow-up with Emily. The export timeout is still open, and now dashboard filters reset when they refresh the page. Patient, but wants a date. Holding off chasing the overdue invoices until we have a fix date for the export.
